method: Full-field editorial translation with era-specific historical research; not an independent scholarly certification.

sourceExceptions.reason: On the trial read contextually as campaign trail, not a court trial; English unchanged.

revisions.source: To be fair, you've appeared with people across the Democratic spectrum, and you shouldn't ignore your Southern base completely.
revisions.zh: 公平地说，你与民主党各派人士都一同露过面，也不应完全忽视南方基本盘。

revisions.source: This might be true, but there are more people in your Party opposed to Wallace than supportive of him.
revisions.zh: 这或许属实，但党内反对华莱士的人，比支持他的人更多。

revisions.source: This might play well in the South, but it definitely detracts from your national appeal.
revisions.zh: 这或许在南方讨好，但肯定会削弱你在全国的吸引力。

revisions.source: It was a bad idea to do this interview in the first place. The least you can do is show some contrition.
revisions.zh: 当初接受这场采访就是个坏主意。你至少应该表现出一点悔意。

revisions.source: It's probably smart to cut your losses and move on from this issue. But for the first time now, a lot of people are questioning your judgment...
revisions.zh: 及时止损、翻过这一页，大概是明智的。不过，现在第一次有许多人开始怀疑你的判断力……

revisions.source: It was a bad idea to do this interview in the first place. You don't need to make things worse by digging your heels in.
revisions.zh: 当初接受这场采访就是个坏主意。你没必要死不认错，把事情弄得更糟。

revisions.source: You've gained a bit for being honest, but this can't be good for your chances in Texas.
revisions.zh: 诚实让你得到了一点好处，但这肯定不利于你在得克萨斯州的胜算。

revisions.source: Probably a smart move to walk back from these comments, although it does undermine your claims to honesty by a small amount.
revisions.zh: 收回这些话，大概是明智的做法，尽管多少损害了你自称诚实的形象。

revisions.source: Unfortunately there's not much you can do with this awkward situation. But you've spoken out enough for Civil Rights that this shouldn't hurt you too much...
revisions.zh: 不幸的是，面对这个尴尬局面，你能做的不多。不过，你为民权说过足够多的话，应该不会受到太大损害……

revisions.source: This answer sounds too strident and waffling to have much appeal on either side. Hopefully the damage is limited.
revisions.zh: 这个回答语气太冲，又摇摆不定，很难讨好任何一方。希望损害有限。

revisions.source: It's nice to talk about the New South, but there is sure to be a backlash (especially from the Southern Baptist vote). On the other hand, this could help you a bit elsewhere.
revisions.zh: 谈新南方当然不错，但肯定会引发反弹，尤其是在美南浸信会选民中。另一方面，这也可能让你在其他地方略有收获。

revisions.source: Walter Mondale is a popular choice among mainstream Democrats.
revisions.zh: 沃尔特·蒙代尔是主流民主党人欢迎的选择。

revisions.source: This is a strong answer, but it certainly helps you with the Jewish vote in New York and elsewhere.
revisions.zh: 这个回答很强硬，不过，它确实有助于你争取纽约和其他地方的犹太选票。

revisions.source: This is a good enough answer, but some Jewish supporters were hoping for more.
revisions.zh: 这个回答已经不错，但一些犹太人支持者原本期待你说得更多。

revisions.source: Your position on this controversy has become news itself. People are wondering if you're opposed to Israel or the Jewish people, and it is not helping you on the trial.
revisions.zh: 你对这场争议的立场，本身已经成了新闻。人们在猜测，你是否反对以色列或犹太人，这对你的竞选没有帮助。

revisions.source: This is a good liberal answer, but perhaps a bit too liberal.
revisions.zh: 这是个不错的自由派回答，但也许有点过于自由派了。

revisions.source: This is not the best response for a Democrat.
revisions.zh: 对民主党人来说，这不是最好的回应。

revisions.source: This is a controversial answer, but as an outsider it could help feed your popularity.
revisions.zh: 这个回答有争议，但你是个局外人，或许反而能借此提升人气。

revisions.source: This is the mainstream answer shared by all major politicians (unless you count a guy like Reagan).
revisions.zh: 这是所有主要政治人物共同持有的主流回答，除非你也把里根那样的人算进去。

revisions.source: Even Gerald Ford supports this Amendment. Some wings of the party are pretty disappointed in this stance.
revisions.zh: 连杰拉尔德·福特都支持这项修正案。党内一些派别对你的立场相当失望。

revisions.source: Even Gerald Ford supports this Amendment. It's good to win the labor vote, but there are other factors to consider as well.
revisions.zh: 连杰拉尔德·福特都支持这项修正案。争取劳工选票固然好，但也得考虑其他因素。

revisions.source: Busing is not a popular policy, but to come out so strongly against it offends some in your party.
revisions.zh: 校车接送不是受欢迎的政策，但你如此强烈地反对，也冒犯了党内一些人。

revisions.source: You've taken the same position as Ford on this issue. But it is probably the majority view at this time.
revisions.zh: 你在这个问题上采取了与福特相同的立场。不过，它大概也是目前多数人的看法。

revisions.source: You've offended nobody, but also pleased nobody. There are whispers from some that you can't take a stand on any important issue.
revisions.zh: 你没有冒犯任何人，也没有让任何人满意。有人私下议论，说你在任何重要问题上都拿不出立场。

revisions.source: This issue divides your party, and you've cast your lot very clearly. Let's see what happens.
revisions.zh: 这个问题让党内意见分裂，而你已经明确选边站了。看看会发生什么吧。

revisions.source: On the balance, your party is surprised to hear you take this stance.
revisions.zh: 总的来说，党内人士对你采取这个立场感到意外。

revisions.source: This is a good, safe answer on the topic.
revisions.zh: 这是个不错而稳妥的回答。

revisions.source: What you've said is true, but you've certainly staked out a liberal position on the issue.
revisions.zh: 你说的属实，但你在这个问题上显然采取了自由派立场。

revisions.source: This is another hot-button issue where it might be better for a Democrat to hedge a little.
revisions.zh: 这又是一个敏感议题，民主党人或许还是稍微留些余地更好。

revisions.source: It's hard to know what to do with this question. It might well be best to give a non-committal answer and hope the issue goes away after this election.
revisions.zh: 很难判断这个问题该怎么处理。或许最好不作明确承诺，希望选举后这件事就不再受到关注。

revisions.source: Some in your party are glad to hear this, but it is also an unpopular position in the South.
revisions.zh: 党内一些人很高兴听到这番话，但这个立场在南方并不受欢迎。

revisions.source: Voters don't care much what you do, as long as there are no more gas shortages and long lines at the pump.
revisions.zh: 只要不再缺油、加油站前不再排长队，选民并不太在意你具体怎么做。

revisions.source: This certainly helps you with the urban hard hat vote, but it could hurt you in the South, where most states are right-to-work.
revisions.zh: 这肯定有助于你争取城市建筑工人的选票，却可能在南方伤害你，因为那里的多数州实行工作权法。

revisions.source: This is the type of middle-ground answer that will keep you from alienating any large wing of the party.
revisions.zh: 这种中间立场的回答，能避免疏远党内任何一个大派别。

revisions.source: This is a big break from the Democratic platform. You'd better be prepared to explain this a little more.
revisions.zh: 这与民主党纲领有很大出入。你最好准备好进一步解释。

revisions.source: You've definitely come down with the dovish wing of the party on this issue.
revisions.zh: 在这个问题上，你明确站到了党内鸽派一边。

revisions.source: This is a popular, mainstream answer on this issue. Even Republicans are looking for ways to defuse Cold War tensions these days.
revisions.zh: 这个回答很受欢迎，也符合主流。在这些日子里，连共和党人都在寻找缓和冷战紧张局势的办法。

revisions.source: You've definitely come down with the hawkish wing of the party on this issue.
revisions.zh: 在这个问题上，你明确站到了党内鹰派一边。

revisions.source: This answer is a bit apathetic, and you've missed a good chance to win support from the farm states.
revisions.zh: 这个回答有些漠不关心，你错过了争取农业州支持的好机会。

revisions.source: A lot of farm states are happy to have another market for their grain, and this is a good foreign policy win as well.
revisions.zh: 许多农业州很高兴粮食又多了一个市场，这也是不错的外交收获。

revisions.source: This might make you look more conservative, but it's not the popular answer for this election.
revisions.zh: 这或许让你显得更保守，但不是这次选举中受欢迎的回答。

revisions.source: McGovern lost pretty badly in '72, if you'll remember. It might not the best strategy to copy his policies.
revisions.zh: 如果你还记得，麦戈文1972年输得很惨。模仿他的政策，恐怕不是最佳策略。

revisions.source: This a good way to please your liberal base without associating yourself with the McGovern disaster.
revisions.zh: 这是一个讨好自由派基本盘的好办法，又不用让自己与麦戈文的惨败联系起来。

revisions.source: This is not a good way to win support from the Democrats in 1976.
revisions.zh: 这可不是1976年争取民主党人支持的好办法。

revisions.source: This is a dovish answer, but one that many Americans agree with.
revisions.zh: 这个回答偏鸽派，但许多美国人都赞同。

revisions.source: This puts you at odds with the Democratic Party, but it could help you with the defense hawk types.
revisions.zh: 这让你与民主党立场冲突，却可能帮助你争取国防鹰派。

revisions.source: Americans, and particularly Democrats, do not want a President who sounds like this on the Vietnam issue. Let bygones be bygones.
revisions.zh: 美国人，尤其是民主党人，不想要一位在越南问题上这样说话的总统。过去的就让它过去吧。

revisions.source: This is a pretty liberal policy, but it's broadly popular with Democrats and particularly important to Hubert Humphrey.
revisions.zh: 这项政策颇为自由派，但在民主党内广受欢迎，对休伯特·汉弗莱也尤其重要。

revisions.source: This is a good chance to present yourself as the voice of common-sense and honesty, but many Democrats favor the proposed law.
revisions.zh: 这是一个把自己塑造成常识与诚实代言人的好机会，但许多民主党人支持这项拟议法律。

revisions.source: You have enjoyed broad appeal, but sometimes it is almost too broad. As the election approaches, some voters worry that you can't take a clear stand on many of the issues.
revisions.zh: 你的吸引力一直很广泛，但有时几乎广泛过头了。选举临近，一些选民担心，你在许多议题上都无法采取明确立场。

revisions.source: This is a pretty conservative answer for a Democrat. It sounds like something Ronald Reagan might say.
revisions.zh: 对民主党人来说，这个回答相当保守，听起来像罗纳德·里根会说的话。

revisions.source: This is a pretty standard answer for a Democrat. Of course, if you're elected, liberals in the party (such as Ted Kennedy) will expect you to take action on this issue.
revisions.zh: 对民主党人来说，这是相当标准的回答。当然，如果当选，特德·肯尼迪这样的党内自由派会期待你在这个问题上采取行动。

revisions.source: This is another answer that offends nobody, but also pleases nobody.
revisions.zh: 这又是一个不冒犯任何人、也不让任何人满意的回答。

revisions.source: This is not inspiring stuff to the Democratic base.
revisions.zh: 这些话可鼓舞不了民主党基本盘。

revisions.source: Even Ford is less opposed to health care measures than this. You've taken a pretty conservative stance here.
revisions.zh: 连福特都没有这样反对医疗保障措施。你在这里采取了相当保守的立场。

revisions.source: This is a good, liberal answer, but a bit outside the mainstream.
revisions.zh: 这是个不错的自由派回答，但有点偏离主流。

revisions.source: The party has a little more of a nuanced position on this issue.
revisions.zh: 民主党在这个问题上的立场，要更细致一些。

revisions.source: Settle in and wait for the returns. Hopefully you can hold on for the win!
revisions.zh: 坐下来等计票结果吧。希望你能守住胜利！

revisions.source: This is a good enough answer, but some Jewish voters were hoping for more.
revisions.zh: 这个回答已经不错，但一些犹太选民原本期待你说得更多。

revisions.source: This is not the kind of answer that Republicans want to hear.
revisions.zh: 这可不是共和党人想听到的回答。

revisions.source: Some accuse you of flip-flopping after you decided to bail out New York. It's good to emphasize that they passed reforms first.
revisions.zh: 你决定救助纽约后，有人指责你反复无常。强调他们先进行了改革，是个好办法。

revisions.source: This would be a good answer, but unfortunately you signed off on the New York bailout. It will take some tortuous logic to explain how this position is consistent with that act.
revisions.zh: 这本来会是个不错的回答，但不幸的是，你已经批准了纽约救助。要解释这个立场如何与那项行动一致，恐怕得费尽周折。

revisions.source: This is not a popular answer with Republicans.
revisions.zh: 这个回答在共和党人中并不受欢迎。

revisions.source: You've definitely enjoyed a day of generally positive press coverage with this stance. But behind the scenes, conservatives and veterans are upset.
revisions.zh: 采取这个立场，让你今天总体上得到积极的媒体报道。不过，幕后保守派和退伍军人很不满。

revisions.source: This is the party line, but it's also a controversial issue with much disagreement.
revisions.zh: 这符合本党路线，但也是个争议很大、意见不一的问题。

revisions.source: This is a good compromise position if you don't want to support the Amendment.
revisions.zh: 如果你不想支持这项修正案，这是个不错的妥协立场。

revisions.source: This is a good answer to fire up the base. But women voters, including your own wife, are upset with you. Enjoy sleeping on the White House couch for a few days.
revisions.zh: 这个回答很能点燃基本盘的热情。不过，女性选民，包括你自己的妻子，都对你不满。准备在白宫沙发上睡几天吧。

revisions.source: You've managed to offend everyone with this answer. Sounding conservative and praising labor unions at the same time?
revisions.zh: 这个回答把所有人都得罪了。既要说得保守，又要赞扬工会？

revisions.source: Busing is not a popular policy, and there's not that much to lose by coming out against it.
revisions.zh: 校车接送不是受欢迎的政策，公开反对它，不会让你失去太多。

revisions.source: Busing is a pretty unpopular policy, and even more so in your party.
revisions.zh: 校车接送相当不受欢迎，在你党内尤其如此。

revisions.source: This is a standard, Republican position.
revisions.zh: 这是标准的共和党立场。

revisions.source: In this day and age, this might be the best stance. Voters like the fact that we're not at war right now.
revisions.zh: 在如今这个时代，这也许是最好的立场。选民喜欢我们现在没有打仗这个事实。

revisions.source: You're really thinking outside the box for a Republican. But there will be a backlash.
revisions.zh: 对共和党人来说，你的想法真是打破了常规。不过，会有反弹。

revisions.source: There has been a lot of debate in your party on this issue, but allowing each state to make their own decision is a good compromise, right?
revisions.zh: 党内对这个问题一直有大量争论，但让各州自行决定，是个不错的妥协，对吧？

revisions.source: You've come out more strongly in favor of abortion than Carter, or even McGovern did. You're definitely making headlines today.
revisions.zh: 你支持堕胎的立场，比卡特，甚至比麦戈文，都更鲜明。你今天肯定要上新闻头条了。
